source_findings.title: Book lookup uses caller ID without an ownership check
source_findings.rationale: The handler loads a record from the supplied identifier without comparing its owner to the authenticated principal.
source_findings.remediation: Check ownership before returning the record.

evidence.message: Object lookup has no recognized owner predicate.
